query: Which quasi-experimental designs (panel waves, DiD, IV, RD) are most feasible for validating causal links between interventions/shocks and social cohesion in African settings?

response.query: Which quasi-experimental designs (panel waves, DiD, IV, RD) are most feasible for validating causal links between interventions/shocks and social cohesion in African settings?
response.answer: DiD and RD designs are most feasible for validating causal links between interventions and social cohesion in African settings due to their ability to handle time-varying confounders and sharp cutoffs.
